lessonRef.title: Publication, presentation, or reflection: argument and presentation

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Notice how the explanation names the reason for each step.

items.prompt: A data set is 10, 15, 20, 25, 30. The mean is 20. What is the mean absolute deviation?

steps: Identify what the problem is asking and which quantities, assumptions, or constraints matter.
Build and solve a model, then check the result against the context.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A student claims a box that is 2 by 4 by 8 units has a volume of 71 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: No; the volume is 64 cubic units, not 71.
Cannot be determined from the given information.
Yes; the volume is 71 cubic units.
No; the volume is 73 cubic units, not 71.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $13 base fee plus $4 per hour. A customer's total bill was $61. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?

A diver starts at the surface (0 m) and descends 9 m, then descends another 21 m, then ascends 20 m. The dive plan assumes a depth limit of 48 m below the surface. What is the diver's final position, as a signed number of meters?
A model predicts a $380 rate will decrease by 10%. What does the model predict as the new rate?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Explain your method so that someone who has not done this unit could follow it.

items.prompt: A storage container is designed as a rectangular prism 9 ft long, 4 ft wide, and 3 ft high. What is its volume in cubic feet?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A data set has the values 47, 62, 77, 92, 107. The mean is 77. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
